response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT scans.arcref, projects.fundflux, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) as rate FROM scans INNER JOIN projects ON scans.arcref = projects.arcregistry GROUP BY scans.arcref, projects.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.avg_rate as gap FROM project_rates pr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE pr.rate > b.avg_rate ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
